not checked: whether robotd is running, what it wrote to reg 50, or whether the bridge answers -- for reg 50 read it back on the robot after robotd starts.
Also not in this file: reg6 (baud) and reg33 (mode). robotd CHECKS those and refuses to open the bus on a mismatch (feetech.rs:386); the rate is compiled in (500 kbps) and the servo ships at 1 Mbps, so they must be moved on the servo.
